Overview.Name: Anusha
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & vegetable dosa (1)
Option 2: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: Vegetable upma (medium bowl) & boiled egg (1)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & dal (1 bowl) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & grilled chicken (moderate portion) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Chicken stir fry (light portion) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid prawns and bitter gourd as mentioned and keep meals simple with chicken, eggs and vegetables.
Since outside food is a trigger, try to keep tasty home style options ready to reduce cravings.
For better appearance results, keep protein portions steady and rice moderate.
Sweet and fried cravings can be managed by eating eggs or paneer first before choosing snacks.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch to support thyroid balance and steady energy.
